messages:
emma: Quick PR to clarify burst_policy options in Dedicated provisioning. Draft PR #3550. Main ask: show "reserved_only" vs "allow_burst" and a migration hint from old `burst_enabled`.

will: paste a before/after so reviewers can skim. also add a tiny SDK helper to migrate programmatic configs.

emma: BEFORE:
```yaml
provisioning:
  burst_enabled: true
  warm_start: true
```
AFTER:
```yaml
provisioning:
  burst_policy: allow_burst  # allows temporary use of shared capacity
  burst_capacity_pct: 25
  warm_start: true
```

will: add a short CLI example for ops: `rictl provision update t-99 --burst-policy=reserved_only` and note the fallback behavior when cluster is saturated.

tasha: tiny wording nit: prefer 'eviction' consistently (alias: preemption). add a 1-line SLO tip: "exclude eviction retry time when reporting token latency comparisons."

emma: added SDK helper snippet in PR: `function migrate(cfg){ if(cfg.burst_enabled){ cfg.burst_policy='allow_burst'; cfg.burst_capacity_pct=20; delete cfg.burst_enabled } return cfg }`

docs-bot: link-check for /dedicated/provisioning -> found one old anchor `/dedicated/autoscale#table` recommend `/dedicated/provisioning#burst-policy`. Commented on PR #3550.

ci-bot: docs-lint queued -> check for `burst_enabled` occurrences.

ci-bot: lint result: 0 occurrences. staging build pending.

will: LGTM, thanks emma. I'll ping owners for approve and merge once staging is green.
